en: The postcard consists of two sides. The front features a monochrome photograph of a bridge crossing a wide river, surrounded by rocky and wooded landscapes, with a mountainous background. Printed in red type is the caption 'Käfsta Bron.' at the lower left and 'Indal.' at the lower right. Handwritten text in Swedish is also present below the photograph. The reverse side of the card contains pre-printed Swedish text indicating it is for the address, a handwritten address, and a Swedish stamp with a postmark dated 1902.
